The {{PAGENAME}} is a [[vendor]] who trades in materials associated with livestock. He is appropriately married to [[Rosa]], the dairy vendor, and appears to be significantly injured; missing a right eye, his left hand, and right leg. He can be found in the back of the dairy farm, north of the [[Dead Horse]], on the right-hand side.

In [[Game of Crone]], the Shepherd's role is expanded, establishing him as a member of the order of undead hunters, a group of people dedicated to killing vampires. He helps you to find who the Vampire is, as well as helping you interrogate vampire Carl.
